description: Pick qualification requires platform review-count and star-rating minimums. Existing expert, public-designation, and value signals are diagnostic only. Platform data licensing concerns remain unresolved.

selection.minimumScoreMeaning: Binary qualification: all configured Kakao and Google review-count and star-rating thresholds must be met. Complete but below-threshold data has score 0; incomplete data is unknown, not zero.

popularity.label: 대중 관심도 (리뷰 수)
popularity.meaning: Binary Pick qualification requires Kakao review_count >= 50, Kakao rating >= 3.5, Google user_rating_count >= 250, and Google rating >= 4.0.

expert_recognition.label: 전문가 선정 (진단 전용)
expert_recognition.meaning: Retained as an independent diagnostic dimension; never affects Pick selection or popularity score.

public_designation.label: 공공·지역 지정 (진단 전용)
public_designation.meaning: Direct restaurant designation only; retained for diagnostics and never affects Pick selection. Heritage streets/areas do not transfer designation to restaurants.

value.label: 가성비 관련 지정 (진단 전용)
value.meaning: Good Price Store designation is retained for diagnostics only; not a price comparison, taste score, or Pick input.

excludedSignals.invalid_platform_ratings: Missing or invalid Kakao/Google star averages remain unknown and cannot satisfy the corresponding minimum.
excludedSignals.missing_review_counts: Unknown if either required count is unavailable or ambiguous. Missing data never becomes zero or a negative contribution.
excludedSignals.licensing: Existing Kakao/Google snapshot reuse concerns remain unresolved; this profile does not authorize refresh or expanded use.
